counter_evidence.text: The flagd EventStream ERROR spans are a recurring background rather than a new burst: 24h increase is 8.09 for each of ad, flagd and recommendation, and hourly increases of 2.14 (sample at 19:34:04Z) and 6.10 (sample at 20:34:04Z) show the errors also occurred well before the PlaceOrder failures; flagd's ResolveBoolean/ResolveInt/ResolveFloat spans show no ERROR status in the 30m view.

fact.text: The alert expression's ratio for checkout oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder SERVER spans reached 1.0 at 2026-11-17T20:33:04Z and 2026-11-17T20:34:04Z and was 0.708 at 20:32:04Z, above the 0.5 threshold.

In the 10 minutes to 2026-11-17T20:34:04Z, checkout span counts (spans, not requests) were 8.92 for span_name oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder with status_code STATUS_CODE_ERROR versus 7.78 with STATUS_CODE_UNSET; the matching outbound span oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge had the same 8.92 ERROR / 7.78 UNSET split.

The failures are new within the sampled window: increase of checkout oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder SERVER STATUS_CODE_ERROR spans over 24h (2026-11-16T20:34:04Z to 2026-11-17T20:34:04Z) is 8.92, the same value as the 10m increase, i.e. the sampled preceding 24h shows no PlaceOrder error spans.

In the returned checkout trace sample, PlaceOrder SERVER spans with rpc.grpc.status_code=0 succeeded with start times 20:24:27Z, 20:25:27Z, 20:26:46Z and 20:27:31Z, while the earliest error PlaceOrder span in the sample started at 20:29:30Z (trace 80d643d1b20fbcd1fc09d4e09d92074c).

checkout's failing oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder server spans carry otel.status_description 'failed to charge card: could not charge the card: rpc error: code = Unknown desc = Payment request failed. Invalid token. app.loyalty.level=gold' with rpc.grpc.status_code=13, and its client span oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge carries the same description with rpc.grpc.status_code=2.

The error originates inside payment: payment's SERVER span grpc.oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge (service_version 2.0.2) has otel.status_code ERROR with grpc.error_message 'Payment request failed. Invalid token. app.loyalty.level=gold' and an exception.stacktrace pointing at module.exports.charge (/usr/src/app/charge.js:37), with duration_us 574-825 in the sample; the omitted-parent case does not apply because these payment spans list a visible CHILD_OF parent spanID (e.g. 4c963179616f35ee), which is checkout's client span 4c963179616f35ee of operation oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge.

payment's Charge span counters show successful charges stopping and errors starting: STATUS_CODE_UNSET is flat at 107 from 20:29:04Z through 20:34:04Z, and STATUS_CODE_ERROR goes 0 at 20:31:04Z, 5 at 20:32:04Z, 6 at 20:33:04Z, 7 at 20:34:04Z.

payment's application transaction counter app_payment_transactions_total is flat from 20:29:04Z onward (app_payment_currency USD 95, CAD 12 at 20:29:04Z and unchanged at 20:34:04Z) on pod payment-6f7bc865d6-k4hpb, i.e. no successful transactions were recorded after 20:29:04Z in this view.

The checkout Deployment was replaced during the window by a configuration-only rollout: pod checkout-6578865d87-jjtmt is present 19:34:04Z-20:19:04Z and pod checkout-5bd784676b-g8khs appears from 20:24:04Z, both with the identical image_id ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo@sha256:5ab0d7b9003206a32c72ef48b42a535c3f70565251d7d832f86fe9f249f16635, and kube_deployment_status_replicas_ready{namespace=otel-demo,deployment=checkout} is 1 at every 5m sample of the hour.

The payment pod did not change in the window: payment-6f7bc865d6-k4hpb is present at every 5m sample from 19:34:04Z to 20:34:04Z with image_id ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo@sha256:33f327b357617379bfa3b292f430d1f06e66e2872494125a40bae14d8fe57d87, and kube_deployment_status_replicas_ready{deployment=payment} is 1 throughout.

No otel-demo pod other than the checkout replacement appeared or disappeared in the 19:34:04Z-20:34:04Z range: 23 pods were returned, including flagd-d6485586b-lv45h and payment-6f7bc865d6-k4hpb present at all 13 five-minute samples.

In the 15m to 20:34:04Z the only error spans beyond the checkout/payment path are the pre-existing flagd EventStream errors: load-generator POST 8.92, frontend-proxy ingress and router frontend egress 8.92, frontend POST / executing api route (pages) /api/checkout / grpc.oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder 8.92, checkout oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder 8.92 and oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge 8.92, payment grpc.oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge 8.92, and flagd.evaluation.v1.Service/EventStream 2.14 on ad, flagd and recommendation.

checkout's other dependencies show no error spans in the 15m view: cart EmptyCart/GetCart, currency Convert, product-catalog GetProduct and shipping GetQuote/ShipOrder appear only with STATUS_CODE_UNSET in the 10m per-span breakdown, and no error series exists for those services in the 15m error query.

checkout's own server-side RPC metric records the failure as gRPC status 13: rpc_server_duration_milliseconds_count{service_name="checkout"} shows rpc_grpc_status_code=13 at 8.23 and 0 at 6.67 increase over 10m; no series with service_name="payment" was returned for rpc_server_duration_milliseconds_count in that query, so payment's server-side RPC status labels are unknown.

hypothesis.text: The rejection is decided inside payment by a flagd/OpenFeature evaluation that involves the loyalty-level attribute, not by a network or timeout failure: the error text appends 'app.loyalty.level=gold' (an OpenFeature evaluation-context attribute), payment emits flagd evaluation spans (grpc.flagd.evaluation.v1.Service/ResolveFloat at 1.11 per 10m in payment), and the rejections take under 1ms with no downstream call; a flag/targeting change at ~20:29Z would explain 100% rejection without any payment or flagd pod change, but flag definitions and change history are not integrated, so this is unproven.

Alternatively the configuration-only checkout rollout (new ReplicaSet checkout-5bd784676b, pod checkout-5bd784676b-g8khs) could have changed values checkout sends (loyalty level / charge token) so that payment's validation now rejects them; counter-indication: that new pod served successful PlaceOrder calls at 20:24:27Z-20:27:31Z and the first observed failure is at 20:29:30Z, so the ~5-9 minute gap and the request-vs-decision distinction are unresolved because the Deployment spec/env is not observable.

recommendation.text: Compare flagd flag definitions/targeting (especially anything keyed on app.loyalty.level) before and after ~20:29Z, and diff the checkout Deployment env between ReplicaSet checkout-6578865d87 and checkout-5bd784676b, to decide between the flag-targeting and request-content hypotheses.

rejected_hypothesis.text: Rejected: the checkout rollout introduced a new container image/build. Both the retired pod checkout-6578865d87-jjtmt and the replacement checkout-5bd784676b-g8khs run the identical image_id sha256:5ab0d7b9003206a32c72ef48b42a535c3f70565251d7d832f86fe9f249f16635, which is the signature of a configuration-only deployment.

Rejected: a payment rollout/restart caused the failures. payment-6f7bc865d6-k4hpb kept the same image digest and was present at every 5m sample of the hour, kube_deployment_status_replicas_ready{deployment=payment} stayed 1, and payment's error counter only started after 20:29Z, so no payment pod change coincides with the onset.
